coordinate_system: normalized x,y, origin top-left; use the uncropped master image as the reference
description: Fictionalized Naches/Yakima Valley landscape. Not a photograph or an exact map of any specific viewpoint.

anchors.name: Eastern dry foothills
anchors.preserve: Rising golden slopes above right-hand valley

anchors.name: River S-bend
anchors.preserve: Waterway enters center, bends left then sweeps to lower right; may become a canal, transit line, or dry Martian channel

anchors.name: Western road curve
anchors.preserve: Curving road across left slope; may become elevated rail

anchors.name: Red barn landmark
anchors.preserve: Small distinctive structure on right bank; may become a station, dome, guild hall or factory

anchors.name: Foreground orchard terraces
anchors.preserve: Repeating diagonals; may become vertical farms, greenhouses or enchanted trees

anchors.name: East orchard blocks
anchors.preserve: Parallel crop lines between river and eastern slopes

anchors.name: Foreground apple branch and harvest crate
anchors.preserve: Optional foreground framing; transform to suit the world

world_rules: Use the master artwork as a visual reference for transformations, not just a text description.
Keep the viewpoint, central peak, ridge positions, river bend and broad orchard layout recognizable.
Allow radical architectural changes around the landmarks, including high-rise skylines, domes, castles and factories.
Do not move the camera to a different valley for rare event worlds.
The master artwork depicts harvest season. Seasonal assets reuse the same viewpoint and land features.
Background artwork is decorative; retain all original interactive app content.
